narrative.intro: Orano Federal Services has $900M in contract obligations in FY2026 to date. Orano Federal Services won 3 awards this fiscal year, with an average award size of $300M, and obligations are up 179824.9% year over year. Orano Federal Services shows a large rise from prior years, following FY25 obligations of $500K. Orano Federal Services recorded earlier fiscal-year activity of $251K in FY21, $1.5M in FY22, and $655K in FY23. Orano Federal Services concentrates its FY2026 obligations in a single NAICS market: Other Basic Inorganic Chemical Manufacturing at $900M. The current-year totals are partial and reflect fiscal year to date contract obligations except where tables list total contract values. This snapshot highlights Orano Federal Services' FY2026 federal obligations alongside recent fiscal-year history and the top market classification by obligations.
